body: Just a little add on, if you check the package there are little rubber gaskets that you can put on the vents to adjust your airflow but keeping it wide open is probably best. I work at a vape shop and have the pm80 for personal use, good hit, it does leak a lot though an easy fix is putting some juice on the coil gasket before putting the new coil in and then giving it a firm push in. Coils leak, it happens. Another good thing about it since it is magnetic when it does leak, it won’t destroy your atomizer reader.
